name: motion-ease-back-in-out
title: Back In-out
description: Lùi lại lúc đầu và vượt quá lúc cuối; nổi bật nhưng không nên dùng nhiều.inOut(1.7)).

moworks.author: moworks

options.graph: a canvas to draw the curve on (a teaching guide; none by default)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Target dips −10.5 % (at 21 % of the time) and overshoots +10.5 % (at 79 %) before landing at 100 %, 600 ms, cubic-bezier(.68,−.6,.32,1.6) ≈ GSAP back.inOut(1.7). Rule: eye-catching, do not overuse. Small demo: 1200 ms across 114 px beside the curve graph and a 12-frame spacing ruler (guides, not ported). Params: duration (0.6 s) · ease (back.inOut(1.7) | custom .68,−.6,.32,1.6).
